title: 新中国的梦
en: The Dream of a New China

sents.zh: 一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝。
sents.en: A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor.

sents.zh: 可是那时候的日子很不好过。
sents.en: But life in those days was very hard.

sents.zh: 很多人想：中国要不一样。
sents.en: Many thought: China must be different.
There was a man called Sun Yat-sen.

sents.zh: 他年轻的时候学过给人看病。
sents.en: When he was young he studied how to treat the sick.

sents.zh: 他也去过很多国家，看过很多东西。
sents.en: He had been to many countries and seen a great deal.

sents.zh: 他发现，别的国家没有皇帝也很好。
sents.en: He found that other countries did well without an emperor.

sents.zh: 所以他说：国家是大家的。
sents.en: So he said: the country belongs to everyone.

sents.zh: 他相信中国人自己可以做到。
sents.en: He believed the Chinese people could do it themselves.

sents.zh: 很多年轻人跟着他一起做事。
sents.en: Many young people worked with him.

sents.zh: 他们做了很多次，都没有成功。
sents.en: They tried many times without success.

sents.zh: 一九一二年，新的国家开始了。
新的政府建了新的学校，也修了新的路。
sents.en: The new government built new schools and new roads.

sents.zh: 虽然前面的路还很难，但是大家心里有希望。
sents.en: Although the road ahead was still hard, people had hope.
